<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups in the compound present in the sample. The available tools can provide the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample, which will show signals for carbon atoms. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (around 10–30 ppm). By retrieving the 13C NMR data and counting the distinct signals in that region, we can infer the number of CH₃ groups. We'll first request the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
